title: Recycled Zamak: PPWR drives market maturity and volume growth
summary: Resistant, heavy, and highly malleable, zamak* offers several advantages that make it well suited to the luxury fragrance industry. Its recyclability is well established; the challenge now is to ensure that recycled zamak can meet the sector's demanding technical and aesthetic requirements. Spoiler alert: it can. extraction.key_fact_quote: As the European Union seeks to accelerate the transition to a circular economy for packaging through the gradual implementation of the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation ( PPWR ) [ 1 ] , zamak is well positioned to meet the requirements of this evolving framework.
